project.title: Darwin Through Our Eyes
project.description: A free photo-walk series where international students learn phone photography while exploring Darwin waterfront and markets, ending with a public exhibition of their photos.
project.who_can_attend: Open to all international students studying in the Northern Territory. Entry is free.
project.wellbeing_benefit: Students explore the city, make friends, and the public sees Darwin through students' eyes.
